title: Sample Pooling
author: Opentrons
materials: Input the parameters for your protocol.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the Opentrons P1000 GEN2 single‑channel pipette, Opentrons 1000 µL tipracks, Mercedes Scientific Flat‑base tubes (7 mL, catalog #60550050), Mercedes Scientific Round‑base tubes (5 mL, catalog #GLO110470), and the custom Alphaqua racks.

steps.title: Define transfer scheme
steps.instruction: Plan the pooling scheme to transfer up to three samples from primary racks into secondary racks according to the desired transfer order.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required parameters for the protocol (e.g., source wells, destination wells, volumes) into the protocol builder.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the protocol file that encodes the pooling steps.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons app
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the tiprack, source tubes, destination tubes, and any other labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate the tiprack, pipette, and each piece of labware on the deck. Follow the app’s calibration prompts and use the recommended calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the automated pooling of up to three samples into the secondary racks.
